_comment: S4 (spec-v2/03-selection.md) / Wave 5.8. `modules` is the protected set the basename-contains-selection matcher cannot see. Path-shaped entries must hold a live timer (GA6); bare-basename items are fail-closed matcher patterns (caretPositions), not paths. Basename `selection` is a fail-closed net so selectionReader.ts cannot silently escape. `outOfScope` is a decision that a file is not a selection module — not a waiver. `entries` waive a live timer in an in-scope file; each needs file, enclosing symbol, kind, and a reason that names why the site remains and which wave retires it. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes the call. Liveness checks the named symbol and kind, not merely the path.
